name: Register TimeSpace export checkpoint

on:
  push:
    branches: [feature/trend-registration-time-space-export]

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read

jobs:
  checkpoint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Enforce append-only registration history
        shell: bash
        env:
          PUSH_BEFORE: ${{ github.event.before }}
          PUSH_AFTER: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          base_protection_validator="$RUNNER_TEMP/time-space-external-protection-validator.py"
          base_protection_config="$RUNNER_TEMP/time-space-external-protection.json"
          git show "$PUSH_BEFORE:scripts/validate_time_space_external_protection.py" > "$base_protection_validator"
          git show "$PUSH_BEFORE:config/research/time_space_export_external_protection_v1.json" > "$base_protection_config"
          python "$base_protection_validator" --config "$base_protection_config"
          base_validator="$RUNNER_TEMP/time-space-registration-push-validator.py"
          git show "$PUSH_BEFORE:scripts/validate_time_space_registration_push.py" > "$base_validator"
          python "$base_validator" \
            --repository "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
            --before "$PUSH_BEFORE" \
            --after "$PUSH_AFTER" \
            --phase checkpoint \
            --github-env "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Validate immutable checkpoint manifest
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          manifest=$CHECKPOINT_MANIFEST
          test -f "$manifest"
          git ls-files --error-unmatch -- "$manifest"
          git cat-file -e "$GITHUB_SHA:$manifest"
          git show "$GITHUB_SHA:$manifest" | cmp -s - "$manifest"
          python - "$manifest" <<'PY'
          import pathlib, sys
          from scripts.build_time_space_export_receipt import _validate_manifest
          path = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
          _validate_manifest(path.as_posix(), path.read_bytes())
          PY
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: time-space-export-checkpoint-${{ env.CHECKPOINT_CUTOFF }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ env.CHECKPOINT_MANIFEST }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
